notes.title: New update
notes.notes:
Game updated to v198

- new: boss - Roaming Scum - is spawned and roams around the map in the Survivor mode 
- new: Options Menu - added separate sliders for music and sounds
- fix: enemies movement speed in fps independent now (it was faster when fps was higher)
